title:
Epic that gets initial data from the {@link ReliabilityMlModelScenario} and stores it in the
{@link ModelScenarioDetailsApplicationState} for the Model Scenario Details page.
No payload is expected, it uses the `scenarioId` page param to `get` the scenario data.
The following actions are dispatched:
- [CLEAR_STATE](SettableApplicationState#clearStateAction): Clear the current app state to ensure a fresh start.
- [GET](ReliabilityMlModelScenario#get): Get the main scenario data using the `scenarioId` page param.
- [SET_MULTIPLE_FIELDS](SettableApplicationState#setMultipleFieldsAction): Set the retrieved fields in the app state.
- [GET_CHART_DATA](ModelScenarioDetailsApplicationState#getChartDataAction): Get the data for the Model Scenario
  Details Chart, and store it in the app state.
name: InitializeModelScenarioDetailsApplicationStateEpic
